020
021public class LostOutpostCrewReturnLuddicFind extends HubMissionWithBarEvent {
022        
023        //public static float MISSION_DAYS = 180f;
024        
025        public static String LOCR_LUDDIC_PLANET_KEY = "$locr_luddicPlanet";
026        public static String LOCR_LUDDIC = "$locr_luddic";
027        public static String LOCRL_LUDDIC_DISCOVERED = "$locr_luddicDiscovered";
028        public static String LOCR_LUDDIC_TRANSPORT_KEY = "$locr_luddicTransport";
029        
030        public static enum Stage {
031                SEARCH,
032                COMPLETED,
033                RETURN,
034                FAILED,
035        }
036        
037        protected int rewardAmount;
038        protected int rewardAmountHigher;
039        
040        protected MarketAPI market;
041        protected SectorEntityToken target;
042        protected SectorEntityToken target_system;
043        protected SectorEntityToken luddic_transport; 
044        protected PersonAPI person;
045        
046        @Override
047        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
048                System.out.println("Attempting LostOutpostCrewReturnLuddicFind");
049                
050                if (!setGlobalReference("$locrlf_ref", "$locrlf_inProgress")) {
051            return false;
052        }
053                
054                if(!barEvent) {
055                        person = getPerson();
056                        if (person == null) { 
057                                return false;
058                        }
059                }
060                
061                //genRandom = Misc.random;
062                
063                // If player has already found the Luddics, no mission.
064                //if (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(LOCRL_LUDDIC_DISCOVERED)) {
065                if (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().is(LOCRL_LUDDIC_DISCOVERED,true)) {
066                        return false;
067                }
068                                
069                // No planet means no mission.
070                target = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getEntity(LOCR_LUDDIC_PLANET_KEY);
071                if (target == null) { 
072                        return false;
073                }
074                
075                // No Luddic transport also means no mission.
076                if (!Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(LOCR_LUDDIC_PLANET_KEY)) {
077                        return false;
078                }
079                
080                luddic_transport = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getEntity(LOCR_LUDDIC_TRANSPORT_KEY);
081                if (luddic_transport == null) {
082                        return false;
083                }
084                
085                
086                target_system = target.getStarSystem().getCenter();
087                
088                //  must be given from a Luddic market
089                //if (!Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH.equals(createdAt.getFaction().getId())) return false;
090
091                if (barEvent) {
092                        
093                        String post = null;
094                        setGiverRank(Ranks.CITIZEN);
095                        //setGiverPost(Ranks.POST_AGENT);
096                        setGiverImportance(pickImportance());
097                        setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_TRADE);
098                        post = pickOne( Ranks.POST_TRADER,
099                                                        Ranks.POST_COMMODITIES_AGENT,
100                                                        Ranks.POST_PORTMASTER,
101                                                        Ranks.POST_MERCHANT,
102                                                        Ranks.POST_GUILDMASTER,
103                                                        Ranks.POST_COMMUNE_LEADER,
104                                                        Ranks.POST_ADMINISTRATOR);
105                        
106                        findOrCreateGiver(createdAt, false, false);
107                
108                        setGiverPost(post);
109                        if (    post.equals(Ranks.POST_BASE_COMMANDER) ||
110                                        post.equals(Ranks.POST_ADMINISTRATOR)) {
111                                setGiverImportance(pickHighImportance());
112                        } else {
113                                setGiverImportance(pickImportance());
114                        }
115                        person = getPerson();
116                        if (person == null) { 
117                                        return false;
118                        }
119
120                }
121                
122                // If they're not Luddic, they're not giving this mission!!!
123                if ( !person.getFaction().getId().equals(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH)) {
124                        return false;
125                }
126
127                
128                if (!setPersonMissionRef(person, "$locrlf_ref")) {
129                        return false;
130                }
131                
132                if (barEvent) {
133                        setGiverIsPotentialContactOnSuccess();
134                }
135
136                // Do we need to store the market? Maybe.
137                market = createdAt;
138                if (market == null) return false;
139                market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$locrlf_market", true);
140                
141                makeImportant(luddic_transport, "$locrlf_target", Stage.SEARCH);
142                makeImportant(target.getStarSystem().getHyperspaceAnchor(), null, Stage.SEARCH);
143                makeImportant(person, "$locrlf_return", Stage.RETURN);  
144        
145                setStartingStage(Stage.SEARCH);
146                setSuccessStage(Stage.COMPLETED);
147                setFailureStage(Stage.FAILED);
148                
149                connectWithGlobalFlag(Stage.SEARCH, Stage.RETURN, "$locrlf_foundHeretics");
150                connectWithGlobalFlag(Stage.RETURN, Stage.COMPLETED, "$locrlf_completed");
151                
152                //setTimeLimit(Stage.FAILED, MISSION_DAYS, null);
153
154                rewardAmount = 36000;
155                rewardAmountHigher = 48000;
156                
157                return true;
158        }
159        
160        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
161                set("$locrlf_barEvent", isBarEvent());
162                set("$locrlf_manOrWoman", getPerson().getManOrWoman());
163                set("$locrlf_heOrShe", getPerson().getHeOrShe());
164                set("$locrlf_himOrHer", getPerson().getHimOrHer());
165                set("$locrlf_hisOrHer", getPerson().getHisOrHer());
166                set("$locrlf_HeOrShe", getPerson().getHeOrShe().substring(0, 1).toUpperCase() + getPerson().getHeOrShe().substring(1));
167                set("$locrlf_HisOrHer", getPerson().getHisOrHer().substring(0, 1).toUpperCase() + getPerson().getHisOrHer().substring(1));
168                set("$locrlf_HimOrHer", getPerson().getHimOrHer().substring(0, 1).toUpperCase() + getPerson().getHimOrHer().substring(1));
169                
170                set("$locrlf_rewardAmount", Misc.getWithDGS(rewardAmount));
171                set("$locrlf_rewardAmountHigher", Misc.getWithDGS(rewardAmountHigher));
172                
173                set("$locrlf_person", getPerson());
174                set("$locrlf_personName", getPerson().getNameString());
175                set("$locrlf_systemName", target.getStarSystem().getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort());
176                set("$locrlf_transportName", luddic_transport.getName());  
177                //set("$locrlf_marketName", target.getName());
178                //set("$locrlft_marketOnOrAt", market.getOnOrAt());
179                set("$locrlf_dist", getDistanceLY(target));
180
181        }
182        
183        protected boolean callAction(String action, String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
184                if ("addPersonToMarket".equals(action)) {
185                        //System.out.print("Adding person to market.");
186                        
187                        Misc.moveToMarket(person, market, true);
188                        if (person.getMarket() == null) return false;
189                        if (person.getMarket().getCommDirectory() == null) return false;
190                        if (person.getMarket().getCommDirectory().getEntryForPerson(person.getId()) == null) return false;
191                        person.getMarket().getCommDirectory().getEntryForPerson(person.getId()).setHidden(false);
192                        
193                        return true;
194                }
195                return false;
196        }
197        
198        @Override
199        public void addDescriptionForNonEndStage(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
200                float opad = 10f;
201                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
202                if (currentStage == Stage.SEARCH) {
203                        info.addPara("Search the " + target_system.getStarSystem().getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort()
204                                        + " for the lost group of Luddic heretics.", opad);
205                }
206                else if (currentStage == Stage.RETURN) {
207                        info.addPara("Return to " + person.getNameString() + " to report that you found "
208                                        + "the lost Luddic heretics.", opad);
209                }
210        }
211
212        @Override
213        public boolean addNextStepText(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float pad) {
214                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
215                if (currentStage == Stage.SEARCH) {
216                        info.addPara("Search for the Luddic heretics in the " +
217                                        target_system.getStarSystem().getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort(), tc, pad);
218                        return true;
219                }
220                else if (currentStage == Stage.RETURN) {
221                        info.addPara("Return with news of the Luddic heretics to " + person.getNameString() + ".", tc, pad);
222                        return true;
223                }
224                return false;
225        }       
226        
227        @Override
228        public String getBaseName() {
229                return "The Stray Flock";
230        }
231        
232}
